```{r}
# making the first figure of weekly data over time
rm(list = ls())
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
# getting the latest data and flitering over time
data_file_path <- paste0("./target-data/time-series/as_of=", "2024-11-04","/part-0.parquet")
  data_file <- read_parquet(data_file_path)
  data_file <- filter(data_file, date > as.Date("2022-01-01"))
weekly_df <- data_file %>%
  mutate(week = floor_date(as.Date(date), "week", week_start = 7)) %>%  
  group_by(week, location) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    weekly_sum   = sum(observation, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# getting the sum for each week
weekly_total <- data_file %>%
  mutate(week = floor_date(as.Date(date), "week", week_start = 7)) %>%  
  group_by(week) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    weekly_sum   = sum(observation, na.rm = TRUE),
    log_weekly_sum = log10(sum(observation, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# creating the median weekly logs per week for each s
weeks <- sort(unique(weekly_df$week))
weekly_log_medians <- c(rep(NA,length(unique(weekly_df$week)) ))
for( i in 1:length(unique(weekly_df$week))){
  weekly_log_medians[i] <- median(log10(filter(weekly_df, week == unique(weekly_df$week)[i] )$weekly_sum))
}
# build a small data frame for the median line
median_df <- tibble(
  week = weeks,
  weekly_log_medians = weekly_log_medians
)
y_ticks <- seq(0, 5, by = 1)
y_labels <- paste0( round(10^(y_ticks)))
# Plotting
p2 <- ggplot(weekly_df, aes(x = week, y = log10(weekly_sum), color = location)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +   # suppress legend here
  scale_color_manual(values = rep("gray", length(unique(weekly_df$location)))) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +               # suppress legend globally
  geom_line(
    data = median_df,
    aes(x = week, y = weekly_log_medians),
    color = "red",
    size = 1.1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,                          # prevents legend from being created
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = weekly_total,
    aes(x = week, y = log_weekly_sum),
    color = "blue",
    size = 1.1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,                          # prevents legend from being created
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(breaks = y_ticks, labels = y_labels) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Weekly Sequences (log scale)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none", text = element_text(size = 15))
# First plot: raw weekly sums
p1 <- ggplot(weekly_df, aes(x = week, y = weekly_sum, color = location)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Weekly Sequences") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", text = element_text(size = 15)) +
  ylim(min(weekly_df$weekly_sum), max(weekly_df$weekly_sum))

# combining the plots and saving the plot
p3 <- p1 / p2 + plot_annotation(title = "Weekly Sequences Across States Over Time", theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 15)
    ))
p3
ggsave("Data_over_time_plots.pdf", p3, width = 10, height = 7, units = "in")
```

```{r cars}
# making the second figure for variant modeling paper, showing the data shifts over time
rm(list = ls())
library("dplyr")
library("ggplot2")
library("arrow")
source("./src-model/func_for_model_submission.R")
library(grid) 
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE) # Suppress message output for dplyr use
# the function for creating the plot
create_plots_for_one_date <- function(states, current_date, clades = NULL, data_days = 150){
  path_to_json  <- "./auxiliary-data/modeled-clades"
  path_to_data <- "./target-data/time-series/as_of="
  path_to_model <- "./model-output"
  path_for_output <- "./model-scores"
# Using newest Hub target data format
df_validation <- read_parquet(paste0(path_to_data,as.Date(current_date + 91),"/part-0.parquet"))
df_validation$count <- df_validation$observation
df_validation$location <- convert_to_abbreviation(df_validation$location)
df_validation$target_date <- df_validation$date
df_validation <- filter(df_validation, date >= current_date - data_days, date <= current_date + 10, location %in% states)
# getting data fit too
df_retro <- read_parquet(paste0(path_to_data,as.Date(current_date),"/part-0.parquet"))
df_retro$count <- df_retro$observation
df_retro$location <- convert_to_abbreviation(df_retro$location)
df_retro$target_date <- df_retro$date
df_retro <- filter(df_retro, date >= current_date - data_days, location %in% states)
# Model output file,needed to get the clades if not inputted not plotted
df_model_FDLDN <- read_parquet(paste0(path_to_model,"/UMass-HMLR_FDLDN","/",as.Date(current_date + 2), "-UMass-HMLR_FDLDN",".parquet"))
if(is.null(clades)){
  clades <- unique(df_model_FDLDN$clade)
}

targets_retro <- df_retro |>
  filter(!is.na(date), date >= (as.Date(current_date) - data_days)) |>
  mutate(clade = ifelse(clade %in% clades, clade, "other")) |>
  group_by(location, date, clade) |>
  dplyr::summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::complete(location, date, clade, fill = list(count = 0)) |>
  group_by(location, date) |>
  mutate(total = sum(count)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(value = ifelse(total == 0, 0, count / total)) |>
  mutate(type = "target")

# Create a PDF file to save the plots
unique_locs <- sort(unique(df_model_FDLDN$location))

# string for printing purposes
date_obs <- paste0("Available Data ", as.Date(current_date + 2))

  targets_retro_this_location <- targets_retro |> subset((location %in% states))

  targets <- df_validation |>
  mutate(clade = ifelse(clade %in% clades, clade, "other")) |>
  group_by(location, target_date, clade) |>
  dplyr::summarise(observation = sum(observation), .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::complete(location, target_date, clade, fill = list(observation = 0)) |>
  group_by(location, target_date) |>
  mutate(total = sum(observation)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(value = ifelse(total == 0, 0, observation / total)) |>
  mutate(type = "target")

  targets$target_date <- as.Date(targets$target_date)
  
  targets_this_location <- targets |> subset(location %in% states)
  targets_retro_this_location$target_date <- targets_retro_this_location$date
  colnames(targets_this_location)[3] <- "clade"
  paired_df <- dplyr::left_join(
  targets_retro_this_location,
  targets_this_location,
  by = c("target_date", "clade"),
  suffix = c("_retro", "_this")
)
paired_df <- filter(paired_df, value_this != value_retro)
print(paired_df)
# Filter to only nonzero values
  nowcast_df <- data_frame(date = c(as.Date(current_date + 2), as.Date(current_date + 2)), value = c(0,1))
  p <- ggplot(mapping = aes()) +
    ggtitle(paste0("Nowcast Proportions and Validated Proportions  \n", states, " ", as.Date(current_date + 2))) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.justification = "center", legend.title = element_blank()) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
  legend.position = "bottom",
  legend.box = "vertical"
) +
    scale_y_continuous(
  limits = c(0, 1),
  expand = c(0, 0.005)
)  +
guides(
  color = guide_legend(nrow = 1),
  size = guide_legend(nrow = 1)
) +
    theme(legend.text=element_text(size=rel(1))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Variant proportion") +
    geom_segment(
  data = paired_df,
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  mapping = aes(
    x = target_date, xend = target_date,
    y = value_retro, yend = value_this
  ),
  color = "black",
  alpha = 0.5,
  arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.08, "inches"), type = "closed", ends = "last")  # add arrow
) +
    geom_point(data = targets_this_location,
               inherit.aes = FALSE,
               mapping = aes(x = target_date, y = value, color = "darkorange", size = total),
               alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_point(data = targets_retro_this_location,
               mapping = aes(x = date, y = value, color = "gray", size = total),
               inherit.aes = FALSE,
               alpha = 0.7) +
   geom_line(data = nowcast_df,
              inherit.aes = FALSE,
               mapping = aes(x = date, y = value, color = "red"),
               alpha = 0.6) +


    # Breaks decides the legend order
    # Default without breaks is in ALPHABETICAL ORDER of labels
    scale_color_manual(labels = c("Evaluation data", "Training data", "Nowcast date"),
                       values = c("darkorange", "dodgerblue", "red"),
                       aesthetics = c("fill", "color")) +
    scale_size(name = "# of sequences", range = c(1, 4)) +
    facet_wrap(~clade)

  print(p)
  ggsave("Figure2_plot.pdf")
}

#create_plots_for_one_date(states = c("NC"), current_date =seq(from = as.Date("2022-09-19"), to = as.Date("2022-09-19"), by = 7), clades = c("22A","22B"), data_days = 31 )
create_plots_for_one_date(states = c("GA"), current_date =seq(from = as.Date("2023-01-09"), to = as.Date("2023-01-09"), by = 7), clades = c("22E","23A"), data_days = 31 )
```

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
# making Figure for section Figure 3, section 3., shows the model fits and training data
library("dplyr")
library("ggplot2")
library("arrow")
source("./src-model/func_for_model_submission.R")
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE) # Suppress message output for dplyr use
create_plots_for_one_date_with_forecast <- function(states, current_date, clades){
  #needed locations
  path_to_json  <- "./auxiliary-data/modeled-clades"
  path_to_data <- "./target-data/time-series/as_of="
  path_to_model <- "./model-output"
  path_for_output <- "./model-scores"
# getting data fit too
df_retro <- read_parquet(paste0(path_to_data,as.Date(current_date),"/part-0.parquet"))
df_retro$count <- df_retro$observation
df_retro$location <- convert_to_abbreviation(df_retro$location)
df_retro$target_date <- df_retro$date
df_retro <- filter(df_retro, date >= current_date - 31, location %in% states)
# Model output file, for the four models we want
df_model_TDLMN <- read_parquet(paste0(path_to_model,"/UMass-HMLR_TDLMN","/",as.Date(current_date + 2), "-UMass-HMLR_TDLMN",".parquet"))
df_model_TDSMN <- read_parquet(paste0(path_to_model,"/UMass-HMLR_TDSMN","/",as.Date(current_date + 2), "-UMass-HMLR_TDSMN",".parquet"))
df_model_TDSDN <- read_parquet(paste0(path_to_model,"/UMass-HMLR_TDSDN","/",as.Date(current_date + 2), "-UMass-HMLR_TDSDN",".parquet"))
df_model_CDSDN <- read_parquet(paste0(path_to_model,"/UMass-HMLR_CDSDN","/",as.Date(current_date + 2), "-UMass-HMLR_CDSDN",".parquet"))

targets_retro <- df_retro |>
  filter(!is.na(date), date >= (as.Date(current_date) - 31)) |>
  mutate(clade = ifelse(clade %in% clades, clade, "other")) |>
  group_by(location, date, clade) |>
  dplyr::summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::complete(location, date, clade, fill = list(count = 0)) |>
  group_by(location, date) |>
  mutate(total = sum(count)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(value = ifelse(total == 0, 0, count / total)) |>
  mutate(type = "target")

# find the locations
unique_locs <- sort(unique(df_model_TDLMN$location))

# string for printing purposes
date_obs <- paste0("Training data")

  targets_retro_this_location <- targets_retro |> subset((location %in% states))
# transforming the model files to get the predictions
   df_out_this_location <- df_model_TDLMN |>
  mutate(clade = ifelse(clade %in% clades, clade, "other")) |>
  subset((location %in% states) & (output_type == "sample")) |>
  group_by(target_date, location, clade, output_type_id) |>
     summarize(value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
     ungroup() |>
      group_by(target_date, location, clade) |>
     summarize(mean = mean(value),
              q05 = quantile(value, probs = 0.05, na.rm = T),
              q95 = quantile(value, probs = 0.95, na.rm = T)) |>
    mutate(type = "prediction") |>
    rename(value = mean)
  df_out_this_location_2 <- df_model_TDSMN|>
    mutate(clade = ifelse(clade %in% clades, clade, "other")) |>
  subset((location %in% states) & (output_type == "sample")) |>
  group_by(target_date, location, clade, output_type_id) |>
     summarize(value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
     ungroup() |>
      group_by(target_date, location, clade) |>
     summarize(mean = mean(value),
              q05 = quantile(value, probs = 0.05, na.rm = T),
              q95 = quantile(value, probs = 0.95, na.rm = T)) |>
    mutate(type = "prediction") |>
    rename(value = mean)
  df_out_this_location_3 <- df_model_TDSDN |>
    mutate(clade = ifelse(clade %in% clades, clade, "other")) |>
  subset((location %in% states) & (output_type == "sample")) |>
  group_by(target_date, location, clade, output_type_id) |>
     summarize(value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
     ungroup() |>
      group_by(target_date, location, clade) |>
     summarize(mean = mean(value),
              q05 = quantile(value, probs = 0.05, na.rm = T),
              q95 = quantile(value, probs = 0.95, na.rm = T)) |>
    mutate(type = "prediction") |>
    rename(value = mean)
   df_out_this_location_4 <- df_model_CDSDN |>
    mutate(clade = ifelse(clade %in% clades, clade, "other")) |>
  subset((location %in% states) & (output_type == "sample")) |>
  group_by(target_date, location, clade, output_type_id) |>
     summarize(value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
     ungroup() |>
      group_by(target_date, location, clade) |>
     summarize(mean = mean(value),
              q05 = quantile(value, probs = 0.05, na.rm = T),
              q95 = quantile(value, probs = 0.95, na.rm = T)) |>
    mutate(type = "prediction") |>
    rename(value = mean)
   # assigning the model names
  df_out_this_location <- df_out_this_location %>% mutate(team = "ILM")
  df_out_this_location_2 <- df_out_this_location_2 %>% mutate(team = "ICM")
  df_out_this_location_3 <- df_out_this_location_3 %>% mutate(team = "ICD")
  df_out_this_location_4 <- df_out_this_location_4 %>% mutate(team = "CCD")
  df_out <- bind_rows(df_out_this_location, df_out_this_location_2, df_out_this_location_3, df_out_this_location_4)
  df_out <- df_out %>% 
    mutate(team  = factor(team,  levels = c("ILM", "ICM", "ICD", "CCD")))
  # submission date for graph
  nowcast_df <- data_frame(date = c(as.Date(current_date + 2), as.Date(current_date + 2)), value = c(0,1))
  fixed_labels <- c(date_obs, "Submission date", "ILM", "ICM", "ICD", "CCD")
  # making the plot
  p <- ggplot(df_out, aes(x = target_date, y = value, color = team)) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.justification = "center", legend.title = element_blank()) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.text=element_text(size=rel(1))) +
theme(
  legend.position = "bottom",
  legend.box = "vertical"
) +
guides(
  color = guide_legend(nrow = 1),
  size = guide_legend(nrow = 1)
) +
    geom_point(data = targets_retro_this_location,
               mapping = aes(x = date, y = value, color = date_obs, size = total),
               inherit.aes = FALSE,
               alpha = 0.6)  +
   geom_line() +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q05, ymax = q95, fill = team), alpha = 0.3, color = NA) +
     geom_line(
  data = nowcast_df,
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  aes(x = date, y = value, color = "Submission date"),
  alpha = 0.6,
  linetype = 2
) +
labs(x = NULL, y = paste("Variant Proportion", states)) +
    scale_color_manual(
          name   = NULL,
          breaks = fixed_labels,  # <<---- sets the order in the legend
          values = c(
            # must include colors for all elements in legend_order
            setNames(
              c("dodgerblue","brown", "red", "green",  "purple", "black"),
              fixed_labels
            )
          ),
          aesthetics = c("fill", "color")
        ) +
    scale_size(name = "# of sequences", range = c(1, 4)) +
    facet_grid(
  rows = vars(clade),
  cols = vars(team)
)

  print(p)
  ggsave("Figure_4_plot.pdf", p, width = 10, height = 7, units = "in")
}
create_plots_for_one_date_with_forecast(states = c("GA"), current_date =seq(from = as.Date("2023-01-09"), to = as.Date("2023-01-09"), by = 7), clades = c("22E","23A"))
```
```{r}
# making the new plot for figure 4
rm(list = ls())
# making Figure showing GA predictions with prediction intervals
library("dplyr")
library(tidyverse)
library("ggplot2")
library("arrow")
source("./src-model/func_for_model_submission.R")
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE) # Suppress message output for dplyr use
set.seed(89)
create_plots_for_one_date_with_forecast_and_PI <- function(states, current_date, clades){
  path_to_json  <- "./auxiliary-data/modeled-clades"
  path_to_data <- "./target-data/time-series/as_of="
  path_to_model <- "./model-output"
  path_for_output <- "./model-scores"
# Using newest Hub target data format
df_validation <- read_parquet(paste0(path_to_data,as.Date(current_date + 91),"/part-0.parquet"))
df_validation$count <- df_validation$observation
df_validation$location <- convert_to_abbreviation(df_validation$location)
df_validation$target_date <- df_validation$date
df_validation <- filter(df_validation, date >= current_date - 31, date <= current_date + 10, location %in% states)
# getting data fit too
df_retro <- read_parquet(paste0(path_to_data,as.Date(current_date),"/part-0.parquet"))
df_retro$count <- df_retro$observation
df_retro$location <- convert_to_abbreviation(df_retro$location)
df_retro$target_date <- df_retro$date
df_retro <- filter(df_retro, date >= current_date - 31, location %in% states)
# Model output files for the models will use
df_model_TDLMN <- read_parquet(paste0(path_to_model,"/UMass-HMLR_TDLMN","/",as.Date(current_date + 2), "-UMass-HMLR_TDLMN",".parquet"))
df_model_TDSMN <- read_parquet(paste0(path_to_model,"/UMass-HMLR_TDSMN","/",as.Date(current_date + 2), "-UMass-HMLR_TDSMN",".parquet"))
df_model_TDSDN <- read_parquet(paste0(path_to_model,"/UMass-HMLR_TDSDN","/",as.Date(current_date + 2), "-UMass-HMLR_TDSDN",".parquet"))
df_model_CDSDN <- read_parquet(paste0(path_to_model,"/UMass-HMLR_CDSDN","/",as.Date(current_date + 2), "-UMass-HMLR_CDSDN",".parquet"))
models <- c("TDLMN", "TDSMN", "TDSDN", "CDSDN")

targets_retro <- df_retro |>
  filter(!is.na(date), date >= (as.Date(current_date) - 50)) |>
  mutate(clade = ifelse(clade %in% clades, clade, "other")) |>
  group_by(location, date, clade) |>
  dplyr::summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::complete(location, date, clade, fill = list(count = 0)) |>
  group_by(location, date) |>
  mutate(total = sum(count)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(value = ifelse(total == 0, 0, count / total)) |>
  mutate(type = "target")

unique_locs <- sort(unique(df_model_TDSMN$location))

# string for printing purposes
date_obs <- "Training data"

  targets_retro_this_location <- targets_retro |> subset((location %in% states))

   targets <- df_validation |>
  mutate(clade = ifelse(clade %in% clades, clade, "other")) |>
  group_by(location, target_date, clade) |>
  dplyr::summarise(observation = sum(observation), .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::complete(location, target_date, clade, fill = list(observation = 0)) |>
  group_by(location, target_date) |>
  mutate(total = sum(observation)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(value = ifelse(total == 0, 0, observation / total)) |>
  mutate(type = "target")

  targets$target_date <- as.Date(targets$target_date)
   df_out_this_location <- df_model_TDLMN |>
  mutate(clade = ifelse(clade %in% clades, clade, "other")) |>
  subset((location %in% states) & (output_type == "sample")) |>

  group_by(target_date, location, clade, output_type_id) |>
     summarize(value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
     ungroup()
#making the prediction intervals
num_clades <- length(unique(df_out_this_location$clade))
locs <- states
dates <- unique(df_out_this_location$target_date)
lower_bounds <- c()
upper_bounds <- c()
for(i in 1:length(dates)){
  for(j in 1:length(locs)){
    state_df <- filter(df_out_this_location, location == locs[j])
    total_seq <- sum(unique(filter(targets, location == locs[j], target_date == as.Date(dates[i]))$total))
    if(total_seq == 0){
      lower_bounds <- c(lower_bounds, rep(0, num_clades))
      upper_bounds <- c(upper_bounds, rep(0, num_clades))
    } else{
     all_draws <- matrix(nrow = num_clades, ncol = 10000)
     output_types_ids <- unique(state_df$output_type_id)
```

```{r}
# making ggplot versions of the plots in Figure 5
rm(list = ls())
library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)

# creating a plot showing the previlance of clades over time
newest_data <- read_parquet(paste0("./target-data/time-series/as_of=2024-11-04","/part-0.parquet"))
newest_data <- filter(newest_data, date >= as.Date("2022-08-01"))
total_clades <- length(unique(newest_data$clade))
target_dates <- seq(from = as.Date("2022-08-03"), to = as.Date("2024-08-07"), by = 7)
total_clade_data <- matrix(nrow = total_clades, ncol = length(target_dates))
for(i in 1:length(target_dates)){
  days_seq <- as.Date(seq(as.Date(target_dates[i] - 2),as.Date(target_dates[i] +4), by = 1 ))
  for(j in 1:total_clades){
    data_from_week <- filter(newest_data, clade == unique(newest_data$clade)[j], date %in% as.Date(days_seq))
    total_clade_data[j, i] <- sum(data_from_week$observation)
  }
  print(i)
}
normalized_clades <- matrix(nrow = total_clades, ncol = length(target_dates))
for(i in 1:length(target_dates)){
  normalized_clades[, i] <- total_clade_data[, i]/sum(total_clade_data[, i])
}

clade_df <- as_tibble(normalized_clades) |>
  mutate(clade = unique(newest_data$clade)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -clade,
    names_to = "date_index",
    values_to = "proportion"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    target_date = target_dates[as.integer(str_remove(date_index, "V"))]
  )
colors <- c("chartreuse","red", "blue", "green", "yellow", "purple", "orange", "pink", "brown", "cyan", "magenta", 
            "gray", "black", "midnightblue", "darkred", "darkblue", "darkgreen", "darkorange", "darkviolet", 
            "gold", "navy", "maroon", "turquoise", "salmon", "orchid", "plum", "khaki", "coral", 
            "skyblue", "seagreen", "slategray", "tan", "thistle", "violet", "wheat", "steelblue", 
            "sienna", "lavender")
legend_clades <- clade_df %>%
  group_by(clade) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(max_prop = max(proportion, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(max_prop >= 0.15) %>%
  pull(clade)
p2 <- ggplot(
  clade_df,
  aes(x = target_date, y = proportion, color = clade)
) +

  scale_color_manual(
```

```{r}
# turning plot into a ribbon showing the range of energy scores and creating a heatmap of scores by target date
rm(list = ls())
library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggtext)
target_dates <- seq(from = as.Date("2022-08-03"), to = as.Date("2024-08-07"), by = 7)
models <- c("FDLDN", "FDLMN","TDLDN","TDLMN", "FDSDN","FDSMN","TDSDN", "TDSMN", "CDLDN", "CDLMN", "CDSDN", "CDSMN")
alt_names <- c("SLD", "SLM","ILD","ILM", "SCD","SCM","ICD", "ICM", "CLD", "CLM", "CCD", "CCM")
path_for_output <- "./model-scores"
scores <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(models) + 1, ncol = length(target_dates))
all_scores <- list()
total_data <- rep(NA, length(target_dates))
for(i in 1:length(target_dates)){
  data_file_path <- paste0("./target-data/time-series/as_of=", as.Date(target_dates[i] - 2),"/part-0.parquet")
  data_file <- read_parquet(data_file_path)
  data_file <- filter(data_file, date >= as.Date(target_dates[i] - 150), date <= target_dates[i])
  total_data[i] <- sum(data_file$observation)
for(j in 1:(length(models))){
  file_name <- paste0(path_for_output,"/UMass-HMLR_",models[j],"/",as.Date(target_dates[i]),"-UMass-HMLR_",models[j],".csv")
   suppressMessages(scores_file <- read_csv(file = file_name, show_col_types = F))
   scores[j,i] <- mean(scores_file$es_score, na.rm = T)
   if(i == 1){
     all_scores[[j]] <- scores_file$es_score
   } else {
     all_scores[[j]] <- c(all_scores[[j]], scores_file$es_score)
   }
}
  file_name <- paste0(path_for_output,"/Hub-baseline/", as.Date(target_dates[i]), "-Hub-baseline", ".csv")
   suppressMessages(scores_file <- read_csv(file = file_name, show_col_types = F))
   scores[length(models) + 1,i] <- mean(scores_file$es_score, na.rm = T) 
   if(i == 1){
     all_scores[[length(models) + 1]] <- scores_file$es_score
   } else {
     all_scores[[length(models) + 1]] <- c(all_scores[[length(models) + 1]], scores_file$es_score)
   }
}
score_df <- as_tibble(scores) |>
  mutate(model = c(alt_names, "baseline")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -model,
    names_to = "date_index",
    values_to = "energy_score"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    target_date = target_dates[as.integer(str_remove(date_index, "V"))]
  )
score_df <- score_df %>%
  group_by(target_date) %>%
   mutate(
    baseline_es = energy_score[model == "baseline"],
    rel_es = log((energy_score/baseline_es  )))
score_df <- score_df %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("CCD","CCM","ICD", "ICM","SCD","SCM","CLD", "CLM", 
   "ILD", "ILM", "SLD", "SLM", "baseline")))
# 1. Summarize data
score_summary <- score_df %>%
  group_by(target_date) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    median_energy = median(rel_es, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_energy  = min(rel_es, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_energy  = max(rel_es, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
score_df <- score_df %>%
  group_by(target_date) %>%
  mutate(best_model = rel_es == min(rel_es, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()
p1 <- ggplot(score_summary,
             aes(x = target_date)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = min_energy,
                  ymax = max_energy),
              alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = median_energy),
            linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Range of log relative mean energy score by submission date",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Log relative mean energy score"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
p1
p2 <- ggplot(score_df,
             aes(x = target_date, y = model, fill = rel_es)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_tile(
    data = filter(score_df, best_model),
    fill = NA,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Heatmap of log relative mean energy score by submission date",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Model",
    fill = "Log relative mean energy score"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
  colours = c("blue", "white", "red"),
  values = scales::rescale(c(min(score_df$rel_es), 0, max(score_df$rel_es)))
) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = c(
      baseline = "Baseline",
      SLM = "SLM",
      ILM = "ILM",
      SLD = "SLD",
      ILD = "ILD",
      CLM = "CLM",
      CLD = "CLD",
      SCM = expression(bold("SCM")),
      ICM = expression(bold("ICM")),
      SCD = expression(bold("SCD")),
      ICD = expression(bold("ICD")),
      CCM = expression(bold("CCM")),
      CCD = expression(bold("CCD"))
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p2
ggsave("Heatmap_by_submission_date_with_baseline.pdf", p2)
ggsave("range_of_scores_by_submission_date.pdf", p1, width = 7, height = 4)
```

```{r}
# heatmap of scores by location
rm(list = ls())
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(arrow)
source("./src-model/func_for_model_creation.R")
source("./src-model/func_for_model_submission.R")
library(forcats)
target_dates <- seq(from = as.Date("2022-08-03"), to = as.Date("2024-08-07"), by = 7)
models <- c("FDLDN", "FDLMN","TDLDN","TDLMN", "FDSDN","FDSMN","TDSDN", "TDSMN",
            "CDLDN", "CDLMN", "CDSDN", "CDSMN")
model_names <- c("SLD", "SLM","ILD","ILM", "SCD","SCM","ICD", "ICM",
                 "CLD", "CLM", "CCD", "CCM")

# making a map between the two sets of names
model_map <- tibble(
  model = models,
  model_name = model_names
)

path_for_output <- "./model-scores"
states <- c(state.abb, "PR", "DC")

# making the list of all files needed

model_files <- expand_grid(
  model = models,
  date  = target_dates
) %>%
  mutate(
    date_chr = as.character(date),
    path = paste0(
      path_for_output,
      "/UMass-HMLR_", model, "/",
      date_chr, "-UMass-HMLR_", model, ".csv"
    )
  )

baseline_files <- tibble(
  model = "baseline",
  date  = target_dates,
  date_chr = as.character(date),
  path = paste0(
    path_for_output, "/Hub-baseline/",
    date_chr, "-Hub-baseline.csv"
  )
)

all_files <- bind_rows(model_files, baseline_files)

# loading in the files

read_one <- function(path, model, date) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(tibble())
  df <- readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  df %>%
    select(location, es_score) %>%
    mutate(model = model, date = as.Date(date))
}

all_scores_long <- pmap_dfr(
  list(all_files$path, all_files$model, all_files$date),
  read_one
)

# getting the summaries for each state model pair

summary_by_state_model <- all_scores_long %>%
  filter(location %in% states) %>%
  group_by(location, model) %>%
  summarize(
    es_score = mean(es_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_files = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_by_state_model <- summary_by_state_model %>%
  left_join(model_map, by = "model") %>%
  mutate(model_name = if_else(model == "baseline", "baseline", model_name))


state_grid <- expand_grid(
  states = states,
  model_name = c(model_names, "baseline")
)

state_scores <- state_grid %>%
  left_join(
    summary_by_state_model,
    by = c("states" = "location", "model_name")
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    states,
    es_score,
    model_name
  )

#plotting the scores

state_scores <- state_scores %>%
  mutate(
    states = factor(states, levels = unique(states)),
    model_name = factor(model_name)
  )
state_scores_rel <- state_scores %>%
  group_by(states) %>%
  mutate(
    baseline_es = es_score[model_name == "baseline"],
    linear = if_else(substr(model_name, 2, 2) == "L",
                        "Linear", if_else(substr(model_name, 2, 2) == "C", "Cubic", "Baseline")),
    multinomial = if_else(substr(model_name, 3, 3) == "M",
                        "Multinomial", if_else(substr(model_name, 3, 3) == "D", "Dirichlet-Multinomial", "Baseline")),
    corr = ifelse(substr(model_name, 1, 1) == "S", "Shared", ifelse(substr(model_name, 1, 1) == "I", "Individual", ifelse(substr(model_name, 1, 1) == "C", "Correlated", "Baseline"))),
    rel_es = log((es_score)/baseline_es)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
state_scores_rel <- state_scores_rel %>%
  mutate(model_name = factor(model_name, levels = c("CCD","CCM","ICD","ICM", "SCD","SCM","CLD", "CLM", 
   "ILD", "ILM","SLD",  "SLM", "baseline")))
# ordering the states by amount of data
all_data <- read_parquet("./target-data/time-series/as_of=2024-11-04/part-0.parquet")
data_ranks <- all_data %>% 
group_by(location) %>%
  summarize(
    data_amount = sum(observation, na.rm = TRUE),
  )
data_ranks <- arrange(data_ranks, desc(data_amount) )
data_ranks$location <- convert_to_abbreviation(data_ranks$location)

state_order <- data_ranks %>%
  arrange(desc(data_amount)) %>%     
  pull(location)
state_scores_rel <- state_scores_rel %>%
  mutate(
    states = factor(states, levels = state_order)
  )
state_scores_rel <- arrange(state_scores_rel, states)
state_scores_rel <- state_scores_rel %>%
  group_by(states) %>%
  mutate(best_model = rel_es == min(rel_es, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()
p1 <- ggplot(state_scores_rel, aes(x = states, y = model_name, fill = rel_es )) +
   geom_tile() +
  geom_tile(
    data = filter(state_scores_rel, best_model),
    fill = NA,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Heatmap of log relative mean energy score by location",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Models",
    fill = "Log relative mean energy score"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
  colours = c("blue", "white", "red"),
  values = scales::rescale(c(min(state_scores_rel$rel_es), 0, max(state_scores_rel$rel_es)))
) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = c(
      Baseline ="Baseline",
      SLM = "SLM",
      SLD = "SLD",
      ILM = "ILM",
      ILD = "ILD",
      CLM = "CLM",
      CLD = "CLD",
      SCM = expression(bold("SCM")),
      SCD = expression(bold("SCD")),
      ICM = expression(bold("ICM")),
      ICD = expression(bold("ICD")),
      CCM = expression(bold("CCM")),
      CCD = expression(bold("CCD"))
    )
  ) + 
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
  )+ 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p1
ggsave("Scores_by_location_with_baseline.pdf", p1)
```

```{r}
# auxilary plots
# doing the same thing as above but with brier scores
rm(list = ls())
library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggtext)
target_dates <- seq(from = as.Date("2022-08-03"), to = as.Date("2024-08-07"), by = 7)
#models <- c("FDLDN", "FDLMN","TDLDN","TDLMN", "FDSDN","FDSMN","TDSDN","TDSMN", "TDSDS")
models <- c("FDLDN", "FDLMN","TDLDN","TDLMN", "FDSDN","FDSMN","TDSDN", "TDSMN", "CDLDN", "CDLMN", "CDSDN", "CDSMN")
alt_names <- c("SLD", "SLM","ILD","ILM", "SCD","SCM","ICD", "ICM", "CLD", "CLM", "CCD", "CCM")
path_for_output <- "./model-scores"
scores <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(models) + 1, ncol = length(target_dates))
all_scores <- list()
total_data <- rep(NA, length(target_dates))
for(i in 1:length(target_dates)){
  data_file_path <- paste0("./target-data/time-series/as_of=", as.Date(target_dates[i] - 2),"/part-0.parquet")
  data_file <- read_parquet(data_file_path)
  data_file <- filter(data_file, date >= as.Date(target_dates[i] - 150), date <= target_dates[i])
  total_data[i] <- sum(data_file$observation)
for(j in 1:(length(models))){
  file_name <- paste0(path_for_output,"/UMass-HMLR_",models[j],"/",as.Date(target_dates[i]),"-UMass-HMLR_",models[j],".csv")
   suppressMessages(scores_file <- read_csv(file = file_name, show_col_types = F))
   scores[j,i] <- mean(scores_file$brier_score, na.rm = T)
   if(i == 1){
     all_scores[[j]] <- scores_file$brier_score
   } else {
     all_scores[[j]] <- c(all_scores[[j]], scores_file$brier_score)
   }
}
  file_name <- paste0(path_for_output,"/Hub-baseline/", as.Date(target_dates[i]), "-Hub-baseline", ".csv")
   suppressMessages(scores_file <- read_csv(file = file_name, show_col_types = F))
   scores[length(models) + 1,i] <- mean(scores_file$brier_score, na.rm = T) 
   if(i == 1){
     all_scores[[length(models) + 1]] <- scores_file$brier_score
   } else {
     all_scores[[length(models) + 1]] <- c(all_scores[[length(models) + 1]], scores_file$brier_score)
   }
}

score_df <- as_tibble(scores) |>
  mutate(model = c(alt_names, "baseline")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -model,
    names_to = "date_index",
    values_to = "bs_score"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    target_date = target_dates[as.integer(str_remove(date_index, "V"))]
  )
score_df <- score_df %>%
  group_by(target_date) %>%
   mutate(
    baseline_bs = bs_score[model == "baseline"],
    rel_bs = (bs_score- baseline_bs  )/baseline_bs)
score_df <- filter(score_df, model != "baseline")
score_df <- score_df %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("CCD", "CLD", "CCM", "CLM", 
  "ICD", "ILD", "ICM", "ILM", "SCD", "SLD", "SCM", "SLM")))
# 1. Summarize data
score_summary <- score_df %>%
  group_by(target_date) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_brier = mean(rel_bs, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_brier  = min(rel_bs, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_brier  = max(rel_bs, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
p1 <- ggplot(score_summary,
             aes(x = target_date)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = min_brier,
                  ymax = max_brier),
              alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_brier),
            linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Range of relative mean brier score by target date",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Relative mean brier score"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
p1
```

```{r}
# making a plot showing off the differences between the ICD and ICM models for GA in Jan 23
rm(list = ls())
library(rstan)


state <- 10
load("/work/pi_maryclaregri_umass_edu/variant-nowcast-model-dev-retro/HMLR_TDSDN.stan2023-01-09.RData")
samplesd <- extract(fitted_model$mlr_fit)
load("/work/pi_maryclaregri_umass_edu/variant-nowcast-model-dev-retro/HMLR_TDSMN.stan2023-01-09.RData")
samplesm <- extract(fitted_model$mlr_fit)

cl <- 1
# cl 1, alpha
# cl 3, beta2
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)  # for layout like your layout()

# Density data
df_kappa <- data.frame(kappa = samplesd$kappa)

# Means
mean_m <- apply(samplesm$raw_beta[, 10, , 3], 2, mean)
mean_d <- apply(samplesd$raw_beta[, 10, , 3], 2, mean)

df_mean <- data.frame(
  ICM = mean_m,
  ICD = mean_d
)

# SDs
sd_m <- apply(samplesm$raw_beta[, 10, , 3], 2, sd)
sd_d <- apply(samplesd$raw_beta[, 10, , 3], 2, sd)

df_sd <- data.frame(
  ICM = sd_m,
  ICD = sd_d,
  color_flag = ifelse(sd_d < sd_m, "blue", "red")
)
p1 <- ggplot(df_kappa, aes(x = kappa)) +
  geom_density() +
  labs(x = "Sample Overdispersion Parameter Value", y = "Density") +
  theme_bw()
p2 <- ggplot(df_mean, aes(x = ICM, y = ICD)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = expression("ICM " * gamma[lv4] * "means"),
  y = expression("ICD " * gamma[lv4] * "means")) +
  theme_bw()
p3 <- ggplot(df_sd, aes(x = ICM, y = ICD, color = color_flag)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_identity() +  # uses "blue"/"red" directly
  labs(x = expression("ICM " * gamma[lv4] * " sds"),
  y = expression("ICD " * gamma[lv4] * " sds")) +
  theme_bw()
p4 <- (p1 + ggtitle("Comparison Of ICM and ICD models for GA 2023-01-11")) /
(p2 |p3)
p4
ggsave("ICD_vs_ICM_plots.pdf", plot = p4)
```
